line: Crowley gives Chesed the number 4, Jupiter and Water; Jung names kesed as one of the two sides of the Tree.

sections.title: Crowley's Fours
sections.line: The Four cards are attributed to Chesed, which Crowley names the Rule of Law and the first sephira below the Abyss.

quotes.quote: These cards are attributed to Chesed.
is attributed to Jupiter, who is the Demiurge.
It symbolises such ideas as Law, Restraint, Power, Protection and Stability.

sections.title: Jupiter and Water
sections.line: Crowley makes Jupiter the planet of Chesed, and Water its element in the Qabalah.

quotes.quote: Jupiter is the planet of Chesed which represents Water in its highest material
In the place of Chesed, which is Water in our Qabalah

sections.title: Jung's two sides of the Tree
sections.line: Jung names kesed and din as the two sides of the Tree of the Sephiroth. He does not number kesed, and he does not give din the name Geburah.

quotes.quote: found lasting expression in the two sides of the cabalistic Tree of the Sephiroth, which were named kesed (love) and din (justice)
